args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate ~18% at time of check; v2.3.1 marked unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release with healthy production status (v2.3.0 was healthy; v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging and was not used). Rollback applied to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and verified. Next steps: confirm error rate recovery, investigate v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It's the most recent release with a healthy production status. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, so I didn't use either.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback, and the verification.

I didn't re-check the error rate after the rollback, so confirming recovery is still open. The incident also lists investigating the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy.

content.text: I'll pull the release history and current status for checkout-api first, so I can identify the most recent healthy release.
The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. The current production version, v2.3.1, is unhealthy in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback is verified in all three regions. Next I'll open the SEV2 incident describing it.
